component: Shared-prefix and multi-tenant scheduling fairness review
implementation: Original regression coverage; no production scheduler or default change
findings: No concrete starvation defect found: ready prefix followers have priority, but the bounded waiter set cannot be replenished without first consuming incoming work and each request waits only once.
Tenant-scoped namespaces prevent unrelated requests from attaching to a foreign leader. Publication, leader completion/removal, capture failure, cancellation, and bounded timeout release waits.
Existing SRPT max-bypass tests cover continuing short arrivals; decode fairness repays finite prefill debt and defers stale host gaps only once per decode gap.

validation.new_real_serving_regressions: 4 passed: ordinary/native MTP crossed with default/SRPT, three cold shared-prefix followers, a decoding tenant and three other short-traffic tenants; exact budgets complete, unrelated tenant first-token and inter-token gaps are bounded in scheduler rounds, checkpoint reuse succeeds and wait ledgers drain.
validation.scope: Tiny actual CPU model/executor/ServingEngine; no full-artifact fairness, latency or throughput claim.
validation.combined_focused_regressions: 78 passed: new multi-tenant shared-prefix tests, existing in-flight prefix waits, SRPT, decode fairness executor tests, and analytic/actual factorized controller tests. CPU-only repair-tree run.
